name: IDC `cptac_pda`
what: IDC v24 collection cptac_pda (TCIA doi:10.7937/k9/tcia.2018.sc20fo18), tier 1 of the anomaly harvest: 62 subjects and 62 CT series verified on fetch (DICOM), about 9.8 GB; chest, abdomen, pelvis and other
level_truth: the data platform records no level labels from the release; its own automatic level calls, which no radiologist has read, are kept apart under its anomaly_harvest folder

segmentations.masks: tumour contours with their seed points: 463 contour sets over 157 of the collection's 757 CT series, in IDC v24; the IDC fetch takes the CT series alone, so they are not on the grid

vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together; the folder holds the 39 collections of IDC's first tier together, 3,499 usable CTs of the 3,600 fetched, and this collection's share of them is not counted here
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

how_to_get: Covered by the data platform's pooled IDC route (idc_tier1), which fetches all 39 tier-1 collections, 3,600 series, into its idc folder in one resumable job; this collection alone is that route's manifest idc_tier1.csv filtered on its first column to cptac_pda, submitted with spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh idc while no other fetch of the idc folder runs, since every IDC entry shares its fetch folder; the check is the count of its distinct series in idc/fetch/verified.jsonl, 62.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid idc_cptac_pda; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="idc_cptac_pda",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
